text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 8: At Donington, metered power plus fitted solar output is the demand without solar, if the fitted capacity is right'
text.tspan: Figure 8: At Donington, metered power plus fitted solar output is the
demand without solar, if the fitted capacity is right

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Donington Primary substation, season-year 2025/26. For each season, the seven consecutive days with the highest mean clear-sky index (CAMS surface sunlight over its clear-sky value). Day 1 to day 7 are those days in order. Fitted solar output is capacity C (4.5 MW) times the output per MW that CAMS sunlight implies. Metered power is power drawn from the electricity network. Adding the fitted solar output to the metered power gives the demand that the solar hid from the meter.'
text.tspan: Donington Primary substation, season-year 2025/26. For each season, the seven consecutive days with the highest
mean clear-sky index (CAMS surface sunlight over its clear-sky value). Day 1 to day 7 are those days in order.
Fitted solar output is capacity C (4.5 MW) times the output per MW that CAMS sunlight implies. Metered power is
power drawn from the electricity network. Adding the fitted solar output to the metered power gives the demand that
the solar hid from the meter.
